senses.definition: A feeling of pity or sorrow for the suffering or distress of another.

senses.definition: Inclination to think or feel alike; emotional or intellectual accord; common feeling.

senses.definition: An affinity, association or mutual relationship between people or things such that they are correspondingly affected by any condition.
